from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialRecord(BaseModel):
    """A financial liability record extracted from a single company's filing."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company reporting the financial data")
    liability_amount: float | None = Field(description="The numerical value of Total Liabilities as reported")
    liability_unit: str | None = Field(description="The unit of the reported amount, e.g., 'dollars', 'thousands'")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The period end date for the report")
    report_type: str | None = Field(description="The type of filing, e.g., Form 10-Q")
    source_quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt containing the liability figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_records: list[FinancialRecord]
